title: JSFL fl.exportPublishSettings missing from runtime
description:
fl.exportPublishSettings(fileURI) is a Flash 8 JSFL standard method that exports the current publish settings to an XML file. It is completely absent from both the JsflFl interface and the makeFlProxy return object in packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts.

CONFIRMED: searching the entire codebase with grep -rn 'exportPublishSettings' finds zero matches.

Impact: Any JSFL script calling fl.exportPublishSettings() will throw 'fl.exportPublishSettings is not a function'. This method is used by automated publish pipelines to save/transfer publish configurations.

Fix: Add exportPublishSettings(fileURI: string): void to the JsflFl interface (around line 4098 in packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts, near the end of the interface), and add a no-op stub implementation in makeFlProxy (around line 4303, near the end of the returned object) that warns to console: console.warn('[JSFL] fl.exportPublishSettings: not supported in browser context'). A no-op with a warning matches the browser-context pattern used for fl.browseForFileURL, fl.runScript, fl.saveMappingFile, etc. No publish-settings model currently exists, so a full implementation is not possible; the stub prevents script crashes.

File: packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts
